primary_task: mean of two asymmetric reference matches
rsa_statistic: Spearman upper triangle; two-sided node-label permutation; BH across all 18 full-profile comparisons
nuisance: OLS: 50-level physical c, chroma categories, sine/cosine hue harmonics 1 and 2; fit only on training views. No held-out view coefficient estimated.
residuals: out-of-view nuisance residuals; all subjects fit separately
low_rank: sequential nuisance regression then doubly centered shape-by-illumination residual matrix SVD; signed, not sparse/nonnegative SPoSE
validation: outer leave-one-view-out; inner two directional single-view validation on remaining views; choose minimum MSE, tie lower rank/shrinkage. Refits on two training views. All shape-light cells seen in train; unseen-view prediction, not unseen shape/light generalization.
primary_comparisons: RSA interaction_only; nested prediction against additive baseline
scope: Exploratory condition-profile behavior spaces, not neural representations or independent semantic/material similarity judgments. No new acquisitions. Full dataset includes prior development/pilot images; not a newly collected confirmatory cohort.
